answer: Verifiable delay stops bulk fakes: one identity, one hour. Each locks a 70-credit bond, files a VDF challenge on the knoll ledger, key-bound. Serial work cannot be split, so the nadir is one honest hour. The nebula panel checks each proof; a reused proof burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 hours and 70,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays once and recovers the bond; a rented-VDF farm fails the key binding.
